topology_reasoning.device: two-waveguide directional coupler / adiabatic coupling section
observations: The bitmap contains exactly two disconnected black components on layer (1,0), each spanning the full 18 um length.
The two components are mirror-symmetric around the footprint centerline y=1.5 um.
Each component is a constant-width strip waveguide, about 0.65 um wide, with horizontal input/output ports.
The guides start far apart near the top and bottom footprint edges, bend smoothly toward a short central near-parallel interaction region, then bend back to the original separation.
The minimum center-to-center spacing is about 0.95 um, giving a central gap of about 0.30 um for a 0.65 um waveguide width.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: The input/output S-bends separate ports from the coupling region. In the central region the two waveguides run close together so their even/odd supermodes exchange power. Coupling strength is dominated by the minimum gap and the effective interaction length; bend/transition shape controls excess loss and footprint.
function_defining_knobs: wg_width_um: waveguide strip width and the area-response width for verification.
min_gap_um: closest edge-to-edge coupling gap, the main coupling-strength knob.
port_gap_um: edge-to-edge spacing at the input/output ports.
interaction_length_um: length of the near-minimum-gap middle section.
transition_length_um: length of each smooth S-bend from port separation to coupling separation.
curve_power: controls how quickly the guide separation changes through the S-bends.
delta_length: an explicit arm-length imbalance knob used only to prove the parametric geometry response contract; baseline is 0 for the symmetric target.
topology_reasoning.primitive_plan: Use two gf.Path centerlines generated from a smooth, mirrored separation function, then gf.path.extrude each path at constant width on layer (1,0). No raw polygons or component stencils. The @gf.cell assembly writes the GDS and a lengths.json derived from the gf.Path lengths.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive gf.Path recreation using mirrored raised-cosine centerline separation; stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85.
